author: Ay_Popsic
body:
Hello, I am somewhat new to avicus yet am looking to get into the competitive scene. I am originally from OCN. If you are interested in me post below or add me on skype (ay.popsic). My KD is utter shit because I play a painloopy playstyle while listening to music to relax. But when required to stay alive I assure you I can.

EDIT: If you are interested in me, please post your team page below and add me on skype. It's more efficient than me asking everyone to personally add me on skype.
